decision.observation: 4 mph, gear 1, timer 56:35.743, all dots pale. The car is off the gravel on the grass strip between the pines (left) and the road (lower-right), nose pointing up-frame toward dense pines. Two white houses stand on the right beyond the road, which curves down-right across the bottom of the frame.
decision.hypothesis: A plain-W burst again drifted left off the road within 0.9 s. The road is behind-right of the nose, so a W+D beat should swing the nose right and back toward the gravel before the pines are reached.
decision.memory: Two consecutive plain-W bursts on this stretch both ended with a left drift off the road (8 -> 4 mph, on grass). Plain W is not viable here; the road's left bend plus camber pulls the car off. Use W+D, and prefer steering beats of ~0.5 s throughout this bend.
